scope: Order-wise model spectrum and separately refitted cumulative/incremental training R2; independent extension of Faure equations, not a published figure target.
preprocessing: Full uniform product [3, 3]; reference is state zero; fitness as supplied. Max order 2; OLS. The forward finite-difference operator is numerically inverted to create the independent design. Model variance uses explicit full-grid predictions by order, not squared raw coefficients.

sources.locator: Eqs. (9), (12), (23)-(25), Table 1 and Methods; the derived profile/spectrum is an independent-equation check.

comparison.justification: Small dense independent finite-difference/inverse-design solves; Lasso budget also covers coordinate-descent order differences. Frozen before production comparison.
